hooks.command: input=$(cat); cmd=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command' <<<"$input"); bg=$(jq -r '.tool_input.run_in_background // false' <<<"$input"); [ "$bg" = "true" ] && exit 0; echo "$cmd" | grep -Eq '(^|[[:space:]])pnpm([[:space:]]+[^|;&]*)?[[:space:]]dev(:[[:graph:]]*)?([[:space:]]|$)|(^|[[:space:]])vite[[:space:]]*$|(^|[[:space:]])vite[[:space:]]+(dev|preview)([[:space:]]|$)|(^|[[:space:]])tsx[[:space:]]+watch([[:space:]]|$)' || exit 0; printf '%s' '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"Dev servers never exit — a foreground pnpm dev*/vite/tsx watch through the Bash tool hangs the turn (CLAUDE.md Build & Dev). Run it with run_in_background, or in a real terminal."}}'

allow: Bash(pnpm *) — the workspace toolchain: install, codegen, lint, typecheck, vitest, builds (foreground dev servers are denied by the PreToolUse hook; backgrounded ones pass)
Bash(node *), Bash(npm *), Bash(npx *), Bash(corepack *) — Node tooling around pnpm
Bash(python3 *) — the stdlib-only plans tooling (tools/plans.py, tools/check-plans.py)

Bash(git add *), Bash(git commit *), Bash(git rm *), Bash(git mv *), Bash(git tag *) — local repo mutations only; push stays gated in permissions.ask, and commits additionally require Simon's per-instance approval as a working rule
Bash(./tools/*), Bash(./scripts/*) — repo helpers (plans register + lint; later the proto sync tool)
Bash(mkdir *), Bash(cp *), Bash(mv *), Bash(touch *), Bash(chmod *) — workspace file plumbing
Bash(kill *) — reaping orphaned dev/test processes found via lsof
Bash(curl *) — local bridge/backend endpoint probes (Envoy admin /ready, JWKS)
